title: Maeterlinck's 'The Cloud That Lifted' foretells the Kennedy assassination
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Maeterlinck's 'The Cloud That Lifted' foretells the Kennedy assassination, about early 20th century play; 1963 assassination at Texas (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Because the same guy who wrote that wrote a play called The Cloud That Lifted.

plain: A researcher and author named Peter Levenda, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, points to a play called The Cloud That Lifted by Maurice Maeterlinck, a Belgian writer who also wrote The Blue Bird. Levenda says the play seems to foretell the 1963 killing of President John F. Kennedy in Dallas, Texas, and he brings up Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of the shooting, alongside it. If true, it would suggest that some writers somehow glimpse future events.
